_doc: nearby (owner 3 Nov 18:50): which Geofabrik extracts the monthly GitHub Actions job (.github/workflows/nearby_data.yml) downloads, in the owner's rollout order. One download per extract per run, one at a time (Geofabrik asks for no parallel hammering). 'countries' = the ISO codes kept from that extract (points are assigned to a country with Natural Earth admin-0 polygons, public domain). The planet file is never used.
